title: TuiLink — terminal client login relay
description: Short-URL sign-in bootstrap, callback relay and draft sync for the wftui terminal client (any XenForo 2.3 forum): /tui-start/<id> 302s into the OAuth authorize page with the stored PKCE challenge, /tui-done catches the authorization response and hands the code to the terminal via a poll endpoint, /api/wf-tui-drafts mirrors composer drafts, and /api/wf-tui-ai relays Ask the AI (WindowsForum's /chat.php) to the terminal. No credentials or tokens are stored - PKCE keeps codes non-exercisable without the client's verifier.
